title: Chibi builds: Kuro as a refined adult, a sly Rei, light tweaks for the rest
question: Are these the right builds, and what still looks off?

media.caption: Your words: "The chibis are bit odd proportions sometimes, kuro looks like a fat short baby rather than the sharp refined secretary". Kuro before and after, in the game with ?chibi=1 (desktop 1366x860): front, her left 3/4, her left side (her idle stance), walking. Same Meshy model (kuro-1), reshaped when it loads: head 0.70 (was 0.85), waist and hips 0.80 wide, trunk 1.15 long, legs 1.7 long and 0.8 thick, arms 1.25 long, hands 0.78, feet 0.85. Her standing height is unchanged (1.12, the scenes' own). About 3 heads tall now, counting her bun (2.2 before).
Kuro before and after on the phone (390x844, the 8k-triangle copy).
Kuro behind the head office counter in the game's own camera, before and after (desktop).
The counter on the phone, before and after.
All ten on the plaza, before and after (desktop): Eric, Mio, Kuro, Mori, Kenji, Emi, the guard, Hamada, Aoi, Rei. Eric, Mio, the guard and Aoi are unchanged.
The same line-up on the phone.

The light tweaks, front and side, before and after. Mori: head 0.82, a slightly fuller and longer trunk (older, settled). Kenji: trunk 1.2 wide and 1.25 deep, limbs 1.08 thick (rounder, as his portrait). Emi: waist 0.94, chest 1.14 wide and 1.3 deep, hips 1.24 wide, legs 1.1 (curvy). Hamada: trunk and limbs about 0.9 thick, legs 1.1 (thin and tired). Emi's change is small on screen; her boxy blazer hides most of it.

Your words on Rei: "The white haired woman also too happy naive looking instead of sly confident saleswoman". New input pictures, in order, edited from round 2's rei-b-101-flip with her portrait as image 2 (FLUX.2 Klein 4B, 4 steps, cfg 1, 1024 px). rei-c: her face only, "a sly, confident saleswoman: a knowing half-smile with one corner of her mouth raised, slightly narrowed eyes under relaxed lids looking straight at the viewer, her chin a little up". rei-d: one more change, "a slim adult figure about three and a half heads tall: a smaller head, a narrow waist, long straight legs and standing tall"; the body barely changed on any seed, so the build is done in the game as for Kuro. rei-c-101 went to Meshy.

rei-2 as Meshy made it (its own previews), under rei-1. Same settings as round 2: latest model, textured in the same task, no remesh, image enhancement off, no PBR, 4k texture; 30 credits. Rigged on a 60k copy (5 credits).

Rei in the game, every step in order (desktop): 1. rei-1 as it was; 2. rei-1 with her build (no walking frame: that capture held the idle); 3. rei-2 at Meshy's proportions; 4. rei-2 with her build (head 0.74, waist 0.84, trunk 1.12, legs 1.6 long, arms 1.2). Hair and suit are still one pale grey, as in round 2.
Rei on the phone: rei-1 as it was, and rei-2 with her build.
